title: Model tracking fields + type enum expansion (6 values) + field semantics lock
objective: Implement the three model-tracking fields in the engine (suggested_model, estimated_models[], models_used[]) per DECISIONS E+H, ensure type enum has all 6 values (spike, feature, bug, improvement, doc, infra), and lock field semantics so engine validation matches docs/DECISIONS.md D.2/E.

subtickets.title: Extend Ticket interface in engine.ts with model tracking fields
subtickets.objective: Add `suggested_model?: string`, `estimated_models?: { model: string; subtask_hint: string }[]`, `models_used?: { model: string; thinking_time_seconds: number; idle_time_seconds: number; cost_estimate_usd: number; context_window_used_pct: number }[]` to the Ticket interface. Ensure type enum already has 6 values (verify: spike, feature, bug, improvement, doc, infra).

subtickets.title: Update create() to accept and persist model tracking fields
subtickets.objective: Allow create() params to include optional `suggested_model` and `estimated_models`. Persist them to ticket JSON. `models_used` starts empty and is auto-populated later by opencode.

subtickets.title: Update update() to allow modifying model tracking fields
subtickets.objective: Allow update() to patch `suggested_model` and `estimated_models`. `models_used` should be append-only (engine doesn't modify it; opencode does at session end).

subtickets.title: Update ticket-v1.json schema with model tracking fields
subtickets.objective: Add the three fields to the JSON Schema with proper types. Ensure additionalProperties allows all documented extended fields (fixes schema mismatch with existing tickets).

subtickets.title: Add computeSuggestedModel() utility (for future auto-computation)
subtickets.objective: Add a helper that computes suggested_model from historical models_used[] data across tickets in the same area. Not wired to create() yet — just the utility function for later use.

notes: Per DECISIONS.md E: suggested_model = auto-computed recommendation from area history (overridable at creation). estimated_models[] = ticket-specific projection split by subtask. models_used[] = actual measured data auto-populated by opencode at session end. Type enum expansion to 6 values was already done in ticket-008 (engine.ts has all 6). Schema mismatch: ticket-v1.json has additionalProperties:false but existing tickets use priority, labels, links, subtickets, notes, estimate, suggested_model, estimated_models, models_used, comments, attachments, spans, assigned_to, parent, is_epic, blocked_by, dependencies — must update schema to allow these.
